definition: צֶ֫לַע noun [masculine] limping, stumbling ; — figurative of calamity, absolute ׳ לְצ Ps 38:18 I am ready ( נָכוֺן ) for stumbling (and falling); suffix בְּצַלְעִי Ps 35:15 at my stumbliing ; ׳ שֹׁמְרֵי צ Jer 20:10 watchers of my stumbling ; אֵיד נָכוֺן לְצַלְעוֺ Job 18:12 ruin is ready for his stumbling. - See also צֵלָע construct
